title: Divriği Great Mosque and Hospital
visualBrief: Individual adjoining Divriği Great Mosque and Hospital medium-fi exterior. Stepped metal hip roofs,eight-sided mihrab stone pyramid,smaller six-sided tomb cone,two low windowed roof lanterns,minaret on rounded northwest buttress,four distinct projecting portal treatments including broad vegetal north entry and tall pointed hospital entry with upper divided window. Exact mapped whole;all internal divisions,heights and relief are picture-proportioned estimates. Shared surfaces,four complete browser levels. Fine calligraphy/carving,interiors,present restoration state,precise steps/site joins and engineering remain unverified.
